newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Wolford jumps over seven pct in Vienna.
newsitem.headline: Wolford jumps over seven pct in Vienna.

text.p: Shares in Austria's luxury hosiery and lingerie maker Wolford AG jumped over seven percent in late-morning trade on what traders said was bottom fishing after recent weakness.
At 1111 GMT, Wolford was the top performer in an overall limp Vienna market, standing 95 schillings, or 7.48 percent, higher at 1,365.

Wolford suffered a barrage of selling on Friday after it announced a lower-than-expected seven percent rise in first-half sales. Its shares slumped to a low of 1,270 schillings, down from 1,420 schillings on Thursday prior to the announcement
"There is plenty of buying at lower levels," said a trader.
